title: Concept: MD5 for security-relevant hashing
description: MD5 is broken for collision resistance and is fast enough to brute-force for password storage, so two different inputs can share a digest and short secrets fall quickly. The call is only a defect where the digest is used for integrity or credentials, which the rule cannot see.
applicability: Any source file that computes an MD5 digest.
risk: Forged integrity checks and fast offline cracking; LOW severity until the use of the digest is established.
